name: Unpacking Universe Dreams
description:
Unpacking Universe Dreams invites you to explore a whimsical world where each box holds new adventures. Unpack and arrange items in vibrant locations, each with its own unique atmosphere. Discover hidden treasures and delightful surprises as you create your perfect space!

Four Engaging Game Modes:
-Classic Mode: Unpack and place objects without mistakes for the highest score.
-Timed Challenge: Race against the clock to arrange items before time runs out.
-Sandbox Mode: Enjoy unlimited creativity as you unpack and arrange at your own pace.
-Speed Run Mode: Test your skills in a fast-paced environment, focusing on quick unpacking and efficient placement.
-Diverse Levels: Navigate through various rooms and environments, each offering fresh challenges and aesthetics.

Discover Something New: Each level reveals unique items and surprises that enhance your unpacking experience, encouraging exploration and creativity.

Transform every space into a reflection of your imagination in Unpacking Dreams!
